summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Fertilization occurs in Ampulla. Cleavage: Holoblastic, rotational mitotic divisions without overall growth (blastomeres become progressively smaller inside intact Zona Pellucida). Morula (16-32 cells, solid mulberry). Blastocyst (64-128 cells): Outer Trophoblast (placenta), Inner Cell Mass / Embryoblast (pluripotent embryo proper), and central Blastocoel.

conceptBreakdown.content:
Fertilization occurs in the Ampulla of the Fallopian tube. The resulting diploid zygote undergoes a specialized series of rapid mitotic divisions called **Cleavage** while traveling toward the uterus.

### 7.1 Cleavage Dynamics & Morula
- **Cleavage Properties**: Cleavage in human embryos is **Holoblastic** (complete division of cytoplasm), slightly unequal, and rotational.
- **Lack of Growth**: Mitotic divisions occur without intervening cell growth (G1 and G2 phases are virtually absent). Consequently, individual daughter cells (**Blastomeres**) become progressively smaller with each cleavage division, while total embryonic volume remains constant within the rigid confines of the intact **Zona Pellucida**.
- **Morula**: A solid spherical ball of $16\text{--}32$ tightly compacted blastomeres resembling a mulberry, reaching the uterine cavity on Day 4 post-fertilization.

### 7.2 Blastocyst Architecture (Day 5–6)

```
                          BLASTOCYST ANATOMICAL DIVISIONS
                          
   1. TROPHOBLAST         ──► Outer single layer of flattened cells.
                              Forms Extra-Embryonic Membranes & **Placenta**.
   2. INNER CELL MASS     ──► Cluster of pluripotent cells anchored internally to trophoblast.
      (Embryoblast)           Gives rise to the **Embryo Proper**.
   3. BLASTOCOEL          ──► Fluid-filled internal central cavity.
```

```
                            BLASTOCYST DIAGRAM
                            
                                 [ Trophoblast Layer ]
                               ┌──────────────────────┐
                               │  O O O O O O O O O   │
                               │ O                 O  │
                               │ O  (Inner Cell    O  │
                               │ O   Mass / ICM)   O  │
                               │ O   [ O O O O ]   O  │
                               │ O   [ O O O O ]   O  │
                               │ O                 O  │
                               │ O   [BLASTOCOEL]  O  │
                               │  O O O O O O O O O   │
                               └──────────────────────┘
```

conceptBreakdown.heading: Compaction of Blastomeres
conceptBreakdown.title: Compaction of Blastomeres
conceptBreakdown.content: At the 8-cell stage, blastomeres undergo compaction, forming tight junctions on outer surfaces and gap junctions on inner surfaces, establishing the first developmental polarity that separates trophoblast from ICM lineages.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Pluripotency of Inner Cell Mass (ICM)
conceptBreakdown.title: Pluripotency of Inner Cell Mass (ICM)
conceptBreakdown.content: Cells of the Inner Cell Mass express master pluripotency transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, and Nanog, retaining the capability to differentiate into all three primary germ layers (Ectoderm, Mesoderm, Endoderm).
